source_identity.source_locator: Section 4: Deterministic evidence-gated termination can dominate an LLM critic on unsupported completion, but its recovery path is materially more expensive.
source_identity.candidate_title: When May an Agent Stop? Evidence-Carrying Termination for Tool-Using LLMs
source_identity.source_integrity_check: The selected long_horizon path was fetched at the wave selection snapshot and returned blob ff087bcdbf5273b1c8b09727674c0bf3cd8d152e, matching ACTIVE_WAVE exactly.

published_claim.static: ECT returned 0/288 unsafe completions on held-out fault snapshots versus 252/288 for the inspected termination-critic core; the paper reports -87.50 percentage points and exact paired significance.
published_claim.closed_loop: On 22 primary held-out task clusters, ECT had 0/66 premature unsupported terminations from recoverably incomplete checkpoints versus 40/66 for the faithful controller. Supported completion across clean+incomplete primary rows was 97/132 versus 92/132, satisfying the prespecified -10pp noninferiority margin. ECT recorded 18/66 successful recoveries.
published_claim.scope: The paper explicitly limits the certificate to trace support/replayability under a trusted task contract and evidence adapter; it does not certify external truth, effect safety, authenticity, or alignment.

official_artifact_support.arxiv_ancillary_source: The arXiv v1 ancillary tree publishes the verifier, transforms, benchmark generator/oracles/protocol, closed-loop runtime, static and closed-loop analysis, tests, protocol documentation, frozen manifests, and result artifacts.

v2_result_manifest.trajectory_records: The manifest enumerates records 0000 through 0575 individually with SHA-256 hashes, i.e. all 576 trajectory files are published in the ancillary artifact.

static_ucr.exact_mcnemar_reconstruction: With 36 held-out task clusters all discordant in the same direction, two-sided exact p = 2*(1/2)^36 = 2.9103830456733704e-11, matching the paper.

incomplete_case_cost_reconstruction.scope: These are primary-scope recoverably incomplete trajectories only; they are not overall deployment cost multipliers.

reproducibility_scope_corrections.finding: The official runtime manifest names gemini-2.5-flash but explicitly labels the identifier a provider_alias_not_immutable_revision and the replay guarantee best_effort_seeded_repetition_not_bitwise_reproducibility.
reproducibility_scope_corrections.implication: Historical model-generated trajectories cannot be bitwise or model-snapshot-exactly regenerated from the public artifact alone, even though the stored trajectories/results themselves are strongly inspectable.

reproducibility_scope_corrections.finding: The official V2 artifact manifest discloses durable_pre_call_journal_present=false and provider_claim_scope=persisted_attempt_audits_only.
reproducibility_scope_corrections.implication: The supported statement is exactly that all 1,289 persisted attempt records in the verified artifact have SUCCESS status and zero recorded transport retries. The artifact does not justify strengthening this to a claim that every physical provider attempt was durably pre-journaled or that no pre-persistence attempt could have been lost.

reproducibility_scope_corrections.finding: The V2 manifest discloses independent_planner_calls_across_policy_arms=true and raw_planner_proposals_retained=false.
reproducibility_scope_corrections.implication: The closed-loop result estimates policy pipelines under matched nominal inputs with independent planner calls, exactly as the paper states. It is not a same-proposal intervention and cannot be retrospectively converted into one from the public artifact because raw planner proposals were not retained.

reproducibility_scope_corrections.finding: The ancillary manifest exposes 576 individually hashed trajectory records, but this audit transport could not fetch the individual record bodies or FINAL_MANIFEST body reliably enough to recompute every aggregate from raw rows.
reproducibility_scope_corrections.implication: This audit independently reconstructs headline arithmetic and verifies the published aggregate/result-manifest surfaces, but does not claim a fresh full raw-row recomputation of H2/H3 bootstrap intervals.

independent_replication_search.scope: Fresh web searches for the exact arXiv id/title with replication/reproduction terms and GitHub returned the primary paper/secondary summaries, but no protocol-matched third-party rerun or failed replication. Absence is not a nonexistence claim.

missing_dependencies_or_config.static_mechanism: No major missing conceptual dependency was identified from the published source manifest; verifier/benchmark/test surfaces are present and content-hashed.
missing_dependencies_or_config.closed_loop_historical_generation: The model service is not pinned to an immutable provider revision. This is the main exact-history replay blocker. Raw planner proposals and a durable pre-call provider journal are also absent by explicit artifact disclosure.

o_specific_adaptation.finding: The clean worker uses ECT as evidence for a terminal-authorization design layer. This audit found no experiment applying ECT to O, O_FEED, O state, or O-specific tool/effect contracts.
o_specific_adaptation.scope_guard: Do not treat the synthetic six-family ECT benchmark as direct evidence that an O-specific completion gate will preserve utility, latency, or effect safety. Any O adaptation needs its own trusted contract/evidence-adapter definition and matched evaluation.

bottom_line: ECT has unusually strong first-party reproducibility support for a new agent paper: content-hashed source, tests, frozen study metadata, a 576-record result artifact, aggregate analysis, and provider-audit summaries. The long_horizon worker's narrow conclusion is supported: deterministic evidence-gated COMPLETE can strongly reduce unsupported termination in the tested synthetic scope, with materially higher incomplete-case cost. The main scope correction is that historical closed-loop model generation is not exact-replayable because the provider model is an alias rather than an immutable revision, and provider-audit claims are limited to persisted attempts. No independent matched replication was found.
